title: 2nd November – Threat Intelligence Report
description: This report summarizes multiple significant cyber threats and incidents disclosed in early November 2026. Major breaches include a $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft from Binance via compromised internal infrastructure, a malicious JavaScript attack on Polymarket's platform, and data breaches affecting Japan Airlines and the Florida Department of Education. The report also highlights the use of AI by threat actors such as the GOLD OGRE ransomware group and North Korean cyber operators to enhance attack capabilities. Several critical vulnerabilities are noted, including CVE-2026-111497 (HTTP2Shell) affecting Brotli decompression, a critical Linux kernel TCP networking flaw (CVE-2026-98432), and a Drupal Commerce Core access control vulnerability (CVE-2026-118539). Cisco patched a high-severity SSL VPN crash vulnerability (CVE-2026-76418) that was exploited in the wild. Additional threat intelligence includes malware campaigns and advanced persistent threat activity targeting various sectors globally.
